Countx: Number of instances along X (grid columns). The input is downsampled to this width; 2 to 256.
County: Number of instances along Z (grid rows). The input is downsampled to this height; 2 to 256.
Spacing: Distance between neighbouring instances in world units.
Basesize: Width of each instance in world units before Scaleamt is applied. Larger than Spacing makes neighbours overlap.
Heightbase: Minimum instance height in world units, added to the luma-driven height.
Heightamt: Extra height in world units for a fully bright pixel (luminance 0..1 scaled by this). 0 = flat grid.
Scaleamt: How much luminance scales instance width (0-1). 0 = all the same width; 1 = dark pixels thin, bright ones wide.
Rotamt: How much luminance rotates each instance around Y, in turns (1 = 360 degrees at full brightness). 0 = no rotation.
Invert: Invert the luminance used for height, scale, rotation and mono colour, so dark pixels become tall.
Colormix: Blend of instance colour from white (0) to the input pixel colour (1).
Noisespeed: Animation speed of the built-in noise source, used only while in1 is unconnected.
Bgcolor: Background colour of the render when Look is original. Mono always uses black.
Modamount: How strongly the modulation CHOP's band1 scales Heightamt: height x (1 + Modamount x band1).
Mix: Blend between the dry source image (0) and the 3D render (1).
Bypass: Output the dry source image (in1 or the demo noise) instead of the render; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: render at in1's resolution (or Resolution when unconnected). custom: always use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Orbitspeed: Camera orbit speed around the grid, in radians per second. Negative orbits the other way; 0 = static.
Orbitangle: Starting angle of the camera orbit in radians, added to the animated orbit.
Distance: Camera distance from the grid centre in world units. Increase for larger grids.
Elevation: Camera height above the grid in world units. Higher looks more top-down.
Fov: Camera field of view in degrees. Smaller = more telephoto and flatter.
Lightangle: Position of the light around the grid, in radians.
Lightheight: Light height above the grid in world units. Also moves the light farther out; lower gives longer shadows.
Lightintensity: Brightness of the main light. 0 = off, 1 = normal, higher over-exposes.
Ambient: Brightness of the ambient light that fills shadowed areas (0-1).
Shadows: Enable hard shadows cast by the main light.
Look: original: use the input colours (blended by Colormix). mono: black background with bone-white/grey instances shaded by luminance.
Accent: Amount (0-1) of red applied to the brightest instances in the mono look. 0 = none; ignored in the original look.
